data.name: LicenceStatusAbsent
data.value: No licence is installed. Every module included with the panel works as usual; installing a licence unlocks any add-on modules your plan includes.

data.name: LicenceStatusValid
data.value: A licence is installed and verified.

data.name: LicenceInstalledSentence
data.value: The licence was installed and verified — its signature, product and expiry all checked out. Whether it is tied to this server is decided by the licence itself: one issued for a named server verifies only here, and one that names no server verifies on any installation of this panel using the same public key. Your licence document says which kind you hold.

data.name: LicenceAdviceMalformed
data.value: The installed licence file is not in a shape this panel can read — it may have been copied incompletely, edited, or is not a licence file at all. No modules included with the panel are affected. Download a fresh copy of your licence and install it again without editing it.

data.name: LicenceAdviceSignatureInvalid
data.value: The installed licence file's signature does not match its contents, which means the file was changed after it was issued, or is not genuine. No modules included with the panel are affected. Get a fresh copy of your licence rather than editing this one by hand, and install that instead.

data.name: LicenceAdviceExpired
data.value: The installed licence's validity period has ended. No modules included with the panel are affected. Renew the licence to keep using the add-on modules it covers.

data.name: LicenceRefusalProductMismatch
data.value: Licence issued for a different product

data.name: LicenceAdviceProductMismatch
data.value: The installed licence file was issued for a different product and cannot be used here. No modules included with the panel are affected. Install the licence file issued for this panel instead.

data.name: LicenceRefusalFingerprintMismatch
data.value: Licence issued for a different server

data.name: LicenceAdviceFingerprintMismatch
data.value: The installed licence was issued for a different server than this one. No modules included with the panel are affected. Use your licence's self-service transfer to move it to this server, or contact support if you believe this is wrong.
